svg.title: distributed suspend rate limiter redis coroutine sequence
svg.desc: DistributedSuspendRateLimiter resolves an AsyncBucketProxy, awaits a remote ConsumptionProbe, maps it to RateLimitResult, converts timeout to error, and rethrows coroutine cancellation.
svg.text: Distributed Suspend Rate Limiter Redis Coroutine Flow
Await one async probe; timeout is ERROR, cancellation is rethrown.
The timeout bounds the remote async operation; it is not a wait-for-refill policy.
